points.text: The intellect is the most superior creation of God, beloved to Him, and serves as the primary means by which God commands, forbids, rewards, and punishes His servants.
The intellect is the essential foundation and guide for religion, knowledge, and moral virtue, without which religious deeds and faith are incomplete or insufficient.
Divine recompense and accountability are strictly measured according to the degree and quality of the intellect possessed by each individual.
The intellect is the primary proof and criterion for distinguishing truth from falsehood, enabling believers to recognize prophets and valid religious authority.
True intellect is intrinsically linked to good character and morals, while deficiency in intellect leads to ignorance, weakness, and spiritual loss.
The intellect was created first among spiritual beings, and it has a counterpart in ignorance, with which it competes through seventy-five armies of virtues and vices.
God created the intellect and commanded it to obey, establishing it as the faculty through which humans recognize their Creator, distinguish good from evil, and attain understanding.
The Prophet and Imams taught people according to the level of their intellects, and the intellect remains the definitive proof upon mankind in the present era.
